title: Chapter 547
text:
The battle began!

Countless beasts surrounded Han Xiao and pounced toward him. Han Xiao changed his hand gesture, and Mechanical Force connected the four mechanical arms. The twenty metal fingers turned into cannon barrels.

Boom boom boom!

The cannons fired, and even the rain was vaporized by the high temperature. The nearby beasts were all pierced through and fell to the ground, howling in pain. Their blood flowed into the muddy water and turned into a sticky, smelly liquid.

In an instant, no beasts were able to get close to Han Xiao.

However, there were tens of thousands of wild beasts, and they seemed to be endless. Under the control of the Mutation Source's emotions, the wild beasts became enraged. Other than Han Xiao, who was surrounded by the wild beasts, even the hundreds of players nearby became the targets of their attacks.

The beast horde charged forward, and their roars caused the ground to tremble. The sound waves even covered the sound of the storm.

As Han Xiao had brought the storyline forward, the Mutation Source had become much weaker. Thus, the number of beasts gathered was much smaller than in his previous life. However, the number of players was even smaller, and only a few hundred of them were present. The boss battle of the Mutation Source was supposed to be a battle of the entire army, but now, it had become a battle of a few people!

The faces of Jupiter and the others changed. The ferocious beast horde was rapidly approaching them like a tsunami. Compared to the massive beast horde, the few of them were insignificant, and it was as though they would be swallowed up at any moment.

Although the interface had triggered the boss mission, and the hundreds of players could not help but fantasize that they would be the one to kill the Mutation Source, facing the avalanche of beasts, this fantasy was mercilessly shattered.

You must be joking. We are so few, and we cannot even charge through the beast horde. How can we deal with the boss of the Mutation Disaster?

The hearts of many players clenched, and they could not help but feel as though they were a mantis trying to stop a chariot. They felt that they were weak, helpless, and pitiful, and they subconsciously wanted to retreat.

The lion-like beast at the very front opened its bloody mouth, revealing its sharp yellow teeth. The stench of blood gushed out, and it looked as though it was about to pounce.

Klaala!

All of a sudden, the sound of mechanical components moving suppressed the sound of the rain and roars. The next moment, countless cannon fire exploded within the beast horde, and the blinding flames seemed to have dispersed the darkness. For an instant, it was as bright as day, illuminating the faces of the players.

The wild beasts that were charging at the players paused in their tracks and turned around to look behind them. A few hundred players seized the opportunity and hurriedly ran a little further away. They looked at the center of the group of beasts in amazement, and their mouths gradually widened.

In the center of the beast horde, four to five thousand mechanical objects suddenly appeared. There were hundreds of flying turrets in the sky, and densely packed mechanical soldiers on the ground. There were panther models, spider models, caterpillar tanks, and so on. They moved nimbly and freely, as if they were real creatures. From afar, they looked like a dense swarm of metal ants.

The approaching beasts were all torn to shreds and did not dare to approach. Steel and flesh stood facing each other. Eight Oathkeepers with different code names silently surrounded Han Xiao in a ring. Raindrops fell on the armor of the Oathkeepers, and the metal glowed with a wet luster.

"Do you think you're the only one with an army?"

The corners of Han Xiao's mouth curled up. He used his energy to construct an invisible barrier, blocking the rainwater outside. The rainwater flowed along the spherical wall of air, and even the corner of his clothes didn't get wet. Compared to the roaring wild beasts, the mechanical beasts surrounding him were cold and silent. They were like elite soldiers that followed orders.

Not far away, the Mutation Source stood on the back of a mammoth that was more than ten meters tall. It did not move at all, and its flattened facial features reappeared. It was also shocked by this change.

More than a year ago, Han Xiao had taken a loan from the Noriose Financial Group. With money in his pocket, apart from building a base, he had expanded the Mech Legion. This army of four thousand mechanical objects was one of his current Mech Legion!

It was called the Mechanical Beast Guards Army!

"These … these are all his machines?"

"What the f * ck, this is the correct way to open a Mechanic class!"

"Oh my god, so cool!"

The few hundred players rubbed their eyes in disbelief. In the blink of an eye, a Mech Legion had appeared beside Han Xiao?

Everyone suddenly realized that this might be the first time Black Star had gone all out since his return!

Regardless of whether it was the few hundred players present or the hundreds of thousands of players watching the live broadcast on the forums, they all had the same thought.

This was the true style of a Mechanic!

A single person was an army!

On the forums, the eyes of many Mechanic class players lit up. They set Han Xiao's performance as their future goal and decided to form their own Mech Legion. So what if he was burning money? This level of awesomeness had already broken through the heavens!

Not to mention becoming stronger, even becoming more handsome was an extravagant wish!

This scene attracted countless players, and they walked resolutely into the abyss of poverty.

"Go, my children," Han Xiao said softly as he activated the army.

Rumble —

The Mech Legion moved in an instant, and the mechanical beasts charged into the beast horde. All sorts of attacks were unleashed one after another, creating gaps in the beast horde. The cannons in the sky followed suit, and all of them were laser cannons with greater penetrative power. Gunpowder and electromagnetic weapons were all relegated to the second line.

The Void Dragon Mechanical Suit appeared on his body, and the thrusters on its back spat out chaotic flames. Han Xiao broke through the rain like a rocket and instantly arrived on the back of the mammoth that the Mutation Source was standing on. The thrusters on his feet activated, and the biochemical muscles on his legs expanded. With a swift knee strike, he landed heavily on the abdomen of the Mutation Source.

His knee sunk deep into the abdomen of the Mutation Source, and a force that was sufficient to crush a building exploded in the air.

Boom!

The Mutation Source curled up like a cooked prawn, and in the next second, it shot into the sky like an arrow released from a bow!

Bending his legs, Han Xiao leaped high into the air, and the force of his jump crushed the spine of the mammoth. The mammoth howled in pain and collapsed heavily into the mud.

Han Xiao caught up to the Mutation Source, and a mechanical hand opened up, turning into a drill. It drilled deep into the chest of the Mutation Source, piercing through and skewering it. However, while the wound looked fatal, it did not affect the Mutation Source at all.

"This kind of attack … is useless against me …"

The Mutation Source was expressionless as it explained the facts.

Han Xiao opened his left hand, and his five fingers formed a claw shape. Needles extended out from his fingertips, and the five fingers stabbed into the face of the Mutation Source. The needles pierced in, and a destructive injection was injected into the body of the Mutation Source.

Bang!

The Mutation Source was like an exploding bucket, and its body exploded, spewing out countless amounts of viscous liquid. It was as though a black rain had fallen, and the skeleton within was exposed. It was then torn apart by the high-speed drill.

Before the black mucus could land on the ground, it collapsed on the molecular level and disappeared without a trace.

The main body of the Mutation Source fell into the mud and returned to its original slime form. The main body spewed out mucus again, and a body that was exactly the same as the original body was constructed. Without the skeleton, this process was extremely difficult, and it took a great deal of effort to regain its human form. While it could not make an expression, it could not hide the fear in its voice.

"I … what happened? You … what did you do? "

In its pitch-black body, white patterns could be seen, and they were like small snakes swimming about. The first injection had taken effect, and the Mutation Source realized that its ability had been greatly suppressed. The moment it was injected, it had lost all the senses of the infected, and it was like an ordinary person who had lost all their senses. It still remembered this deepest darkness. That was when its consciousness had just been born, and it did not have any senses of the outside world.

In that instant, the berserk wild beasts had broken free from the control of the Mutation Source, and their anger had dissipated. Their eyes regained their clarity, but this lasted for only a few seconds before the Mutation Source regained its ability and regained control over them. However, the strength of its control had decreased, and it could feel that it had lost quite a bit of energy.

In its short life, this was the first time it had felt fear.

The eight Oathkeepers were like a barrier, separating the surrounding beasts and leaving the Mutation Source alone. Han Xiao landed not far from the Mutation Source, and when he saw the reaction of the Mutation Source, he had a strange feeling as though he was beating up a child.

A cylindrical groove appeared on the upper arm of the mechanical suit, and the empty syringe was ejected into the mud.

Han Xiao looked at the enemy's information and frowned. He realized that the Mutation Source's ability had only been reduced by a third, and it was not as effective as what he remembered.

He could not help but have some doubts. After thinking about it, he had a guess. Godora in my previous life had researched for a longer period of time, but it is different now. Although Godora has my sample, the research time is too short, and it is in a rush to succeed. It took out a syringe that was still in the experimental stage, and the effect is weaker than in my previous life. It will probably require a larger dosage.

Nagojin had only brought three syringes over, and Han Xiao had wanted to use them to quickly eliminate the Mutation Source. However, the effect of the syringes was not as good as in his previous life, and this was something that he had not expected. There was a high chance that the Mutation Source would not collapse by itself even after using all three syringes.

Dogsh * t! Godora was indeed unreliable, and he still had to use his fists to solve problems!

Clenching his fists, Han Xiao shook his head helplessly.

"Looks like I have to play with you for a while."

On the other side, the mechanical army was working together under Philip's control. The beasts that covered the mountains were all restrained, and even the beasts that were chasing after the players turned around and ran toward the Mechanical Beast Guards that were operating like a meat grinder.

The hundreds of players heaved a sigh of relief and stopped what they were doing. Looking at the chaotic and bloody battlefield, they saw that the attention of the beasts was attracted by Han Xiao, and their thoughts became lively again.

"The beasts are not chasing after us anymore. Right, that must be it. Black Star's Mech Legion is pinning down the beasts, which is equivalent to helping us control the beasts. This way, we will have a chance to enter the battlefield and fight with the beasts. We might even be able to kill the Mutation Source and obtain the first kill!"

Jupiter's eyes lit up, and he was overjoyed.

Although Black Star was currently dealing with the Mutation Source, the NPCs would definitely not care about who killed the Mutation Source in the end. Furthermore, they would receive additional rewards for killing the Mutation Source! This was the opportunity to obtain a top-grade mission evaluation!

The hundreds of players were restless and wanted to snatch the kill.

…

The moment the detector locked onto the Mutation Source, Han Xiao immediately rode the Blacklight Stealth and attacked. He did not have the time to inform anyone, but the various organizations had been paying attention to the movements of the Blacklight Stealth. Not long after Han Xiao fought with the Mutation Source, the Six Nations, Bennett, Nagojin, and the others had used the satellites and other observation devices to broadcast the scene of the battlefield. Only then did they know that they had found the Mutation Source and were overjoyed.

They had found the Mutation Source in just a single day, and Nagojin was overjoyed. He hurriedly gathered his troops and boarded the spaceship to provide support.

Herlous was the same, and he immediately gathered his mercenaries and led them out. Although they knew that Han Xiao most likely did not require any help, how could they watch as their captain fought alone?

If they were made to suffer … cough, even if they were just here to join in the fun, they had to take a look around the battlefield!

Bennett had absolute confidence in Han Xiao. With a wave of his hand, he got his subordinates to broadcast the scene of the battlefield to the entire Sanctuary. All the channels were showing Han Xiao's battlefield, and the refugees in the Sanctuary sat in front of the large screens and watched the scene nervously.

Hella and Aurora also stopped their work of checking the infected and watched the television.

"Sister, look, it's Han Xiao!" Aurora said excitedly.

"…" Looking at the one-sided suppression on the screen, Hella pursed her lips, and a complicated expression appeared on her face.

She thought back to a few years ago when Han Xiao had destroyed the Germinal Organization and ended the war. It was not appropriate to say that he had saved the world, but he had truly saved her and her younger sister.

This time, Han Xiao had truly saved the world. From his return until now, who knew how many people on this planet had been saved because of him? There were at least tens of millions of people.

Although they had known each other for a few years, Hella knew that she had never truly understood Han Xiao. This person was like a closed book, and it was difficult to know what he was thinking.

In the television, Han Xiao had single-handedly fought against tens of thousands of wild beasts. She knew that she would not be able to do that, and in just a few years, she had been left far behind.

Hella could not help but clench her fists tightly.

Only by cultivating with the Dragon Emperor will I be able to catch up to him.

The eyes of the Six Nations were focused on Han Xiao's battlefield, and their hearts tightened.

Only when Han Xiao destroyed the Mutation Source would the calamity on this planet truly end. Only today did the light of dawn shine into the dark future.

The upper echelons of the Six Nations all stopped what they were doing and stared at the satellite broadcast. Even the leaders of the Six Nations were the same.

Everyone was praying in their hearts that Han Xiao would win.
